parts.text: Revise the configured artifact target. Remove Markdown representation from evaluation_heuristic and express the heuristic as JSON-native structured data. Preserve every rule, observation, U/P or expectation-vs-outcome comparator, matching example, nonmatching boundary example, evaluation procedure step, qualification, exception, and caution currently represented in evaluation_heuristic; do not summarize, truncate, merge away, or omit semantic content. Remove Markdown-only syntax and representation such as heading markers, emphasis markers, inline-code backticks, Markdown tables/table separators, and Markdown list formatting by representing their meaning in explicit JSON keys and values instead. Preserve /step3_tsr exactly as supplied; do not change, reorder, normalize, add, delete, or rewrite any test, case, U, P, result, or string within it. Return response_type artifact_revision with the complete revised_artifact only through the configured artifact-revision schema.
